DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL)

The blood smear findings of immature cells with needle-shaped Auer rods (pink, elongated inclusions) combined with pancytopenia and extreme leukocytosis are pathognomonic for APL, not iron deficiency anemia. Given the high WBC count and low platelets, I must immediately request an emergency bone marrow biopsy and genetic testing for the t(15;17) translocation.
